briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 deployment sparks fresh AGI timeline compression across labs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated into mid-2026 with frontier labs racing toward multi-modal agentic systems. Compute constraints and safety gaps remain primary bottlenecks while regulatory pressure mounts in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with 4.2T parameters achieving new SOTA on agent benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 Ultra launched last week; Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1 while xAI and DeepSeek both deployed 2T+ models.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines and EU AI Act enforcement actions target agentic risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced 50GW+ data center expansions; TSMC began 2nm AI chip production ramp with NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra shipments ahead of schedule.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10T-parameter model cross the AGI threshold before 2028?
